articles.title: Bernstein raises Robinhood price target, cites tokenization and prediction markets
articles.snippet: The brokerage’s blockchain strategy, including tokenized equities and its Arbitrum-based Robinhood Chain, could reduce its reliance on traditional crypto trading, analysts said.

articles.title: Peter Brandt predicts the exact day Bitcoin’s bear market will be over
articles.snippet: Renowned trading analyst Peter Brandt says investing in Bitcoin today, will pay off much better in two to three years than buying AI stocks at current prices.

articles.title: Vietnam sets fines for unlicensed crypto trading ahead of regulation rollout
articles.snippet: The new rules establish penalties as much as $1,900 for crypto violations, including unlicensed trading and AML breaches, ahead of Vietnam’s regulated crypto market launch.

articles.title: Crypto institutions look beyond audits as trust signals falter: Hacken
articles.snippet: Institutional due diligence is shifting toward continuous monitoring, signer controls and incident readiness after operational failures accounted for most crypto losses.

articles.title: Russia’s parliament to hold final readings on crypto bill Tuesday
articles.snippet: Russia’s State Duma is set to consider the crypto regulation bill in second and third readings, with rules for investors and cross-border payments included.
